comment: Skipped on rri-mtest: it waits for domainName.processes.delete.redemption_period, which needs 150480 s, the run waits at most 600 s (RPP_TEST_MAX_WAIT); it waits for domainName.processes.delete.pending_delete_period, which needs 63360 s, the run waits at most 600 s (RPP_TEST_MAX_WAIT).
description: A deleted domain can no longer be restored once its redemption period ends (pendingDelete), and is purged after its pending delete period (RFC 3915 §3.1).

setup.comment: Creates contact L8; expects 201. The registrant of the domain below. Only where a domain needs a registrant (rri-mtest).
Creates domain t8 with authInfo, registrant L8 (by backend), dns records a (by backend); expects 201. The domain the steps below work on.

steps.comment: Deletes domain t8; expects 200. The operation this case checks. Waits first for domainName.processes.create.add_grace_period.
Requests a restore of domain t8; expects 409 02304. An error answer this case checks. Waits first for domainName.processes.delete.redemption_period.
Reads domain t8; expects 404 02303. The error answer this case checks. Waits first for domainName.processes.delete.pending_delete_period.
